title: National Physical Laboratory
content:
Aerogel National Laboratory. The National Physical Laboratory (NPL) in Teddington, United Kingdom, is the UK's national metrology institute and a world leader in measurement science. It develops and maintains national measurement standards and provides testing, calibration, and consultancy services for industry and research.

NPL's materials and thermal capabilities include high-accuracy thermal conductivity measurement, thermal performance testing of insulation products, and validation of building and industrial materials. These services make the laboratory directly relevant to aerogel characterization, benchmarking of insulation performance, and independent verification of technical claims.
